title: Mizzen context request
description: A versioned request for task-specific documentation context: the task, include/exclude hints, locale and version limits, a token budget, and the evidence that must survive trimming. `parseContextRequest` validates against this schema, fills the defaults, and returns the normalised request; keys are written in this order, so the same request always has the same bytes. Parsing is local: no network, no model, no clock.

task.description: What the agent is doing; the parser never infers it from other fields.

include.description: Hints that raise a page's priority: a URL, source path, or topic. Default `[]`.

exclude.description: Hints that leave a page out: a URL, source path, or topic. Default `[]`.

constraints.description: Language and site version limits. Absent means no limit.

budget.description: The token budget of the request.

requiredEvidence.description: Evidence that trimming must keep. Absent means nothing is required.

task.description: The task the context is for.

goal.description: The task in one sentence; the parser removes leading and trailing whitespace.

kind.description: The kind of work, when the caller states it. Never inferred.

hint.description: A URL, source path, section id, or topic a page can be matched against.

version.description: A site version folder, such as `v2`, `v2.1`, or `v2.1.3`.

exact.description: Only this version folder; exclusive with `min` and `max`.

constraints.description: Limits on the language and site version of the selected context.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag, such as `en`, `fa`, or `en-US`; the parser lower-cases it.

budget.description: The token budget: an upper bound and, optionally, tokens reserved for required evidence.

maxTokens.description: Upper bound on the estimated tokens of the serialised context.

reservedTokens.description: Tokens held back for required evidence; less than `maxTokens`.

refs.description: Page URLs, source paths, or section ids that must stay in the context. Default `[]`.

source.description: Keep each selected fragment's source path and span. Default `false`.

versions.description: Keep the site version and locale each selected fragment came from. Default `false`.

warnings.description: Keep the warnings attached to selected pages. Default `false`.

dependencies.description: Keep the pages a selected page depends on. Default `false`.
